channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Viking girls beat Kenyon-Wanamnigo to win Gopher East
item.description: Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy tops Kenyon-Wanamingo 54-42 to clinch the Gopher East title; Lily Morrisey scores 18 as Vikings advance to Gopher Championship at New Richland-HEG Saturday.

item.title: Bruins' 8-game winning streak comes to an end in Iowa
item.description: Austin Bruins’ eight-game win streak ends with 4-1 road loss to North Iowa Bulls in Mason City, managing their lone goal in the third period despite 20 saves from Jack Solomon.

item.title: Rebel boys win 15th straight game
item.description: Southland boys top Burros 58-51 in Lanesboro to extend win streak to 15, improve to 22-1 with two regular-season games left; Henry Wiste scores 19 to lead Rebel boys.

item.title: Blue Devil men take down St. Cloud
item.description: No. 2 Riverland tops St. Cloud Tech 67-63 in home finale, improving to 26-1; Tristan Coleman leads Blue Devils with 22 points and 11 rebounds.

item.title: Blue Devil women drop 19th straight game
item.description: Riverland women’s basketball falls 72-33 to St. Cloud at home, extending winless season to 0-19.

item.title: Austin Packer Dance Team finishes season at state meet
item.description: Austin Packer Dance Team ends year at Class AA state meet, missing finals in jazz and high kick, as Totino-Grace and Benilde-St. Margaret's win titles; 25th straight trip.

item.title: Westfield and GMLOS eliminated out in Section 2A wrestling semifinals
item.description: Westfield and GMLOS bow out in Section 2A wrestling semifinals; Kenyon-Wanamingo wins 51-12 as individual section meets begin this upcoming weekend.

item.title: NRHEG Panthers top Viking girls in Gopher Conference championship
item.description: NRHEG tops Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy 78-35 for the Gopher Conference crown, and the Vikings quickly turn to the Section 1A Tournament starting Thursday.

item.title: Bruins shut down Bulls for a 2-1 home win
item.description: EJ Paddington’s 26th goal and Cody Butikis’ 36 saves lift the Austin Bruins to a 2-1 home win over the North Iowa Bulls at Riverside Arena.

item.title: Austin's McRae headed to state gymnastics meet on the beam
item.description: Austin sophomore Callie McRae qualifies for the Class AA state meet on beam with a 9.2 at the Section 1AA meet, where Austin finishes fifth with a 135.675 team score.
